create.name: Sivananda Ashram Yoga Retreat Bahamas
create.bio:
The Sivananda Ashram Yoga Retreat sits on Paradise Island, across the bay from Nassau, on a beachfront plot of some five and a half acres of tropical gardens. Swami Vishnudevananda established it in 1967, and it belongs to the International Sivananda Yoga Vedanta Centres, the family of ashrams and centres that carries his teacher Swami Sivananda's classical yoga worldwide. It describes itself as both a traditional ashram and a modern retreat: a resident community of staff who have committed themselves to a spiritual life live, practise and work together to run the place, with peace through yoga as their shared aim.

Guests follow a set daily rhythm of meditation, pranayama, asana and study, with vegetarian meals, morning and evening satsang, and a yearly calendar of several hundred courses, talks and performances given by senior Sivananda teachers and visiting presenters. Its month-long 200-hour teacher training course runs nine times a year, and there is an advanced 300-hour course and a residential karma yoga programme for longer stays. For people who cannot travel, the twice-daily satsang of silent sitting, chanting and a talk is streamed free on its online platform, alongside paid online courses and an online teacher training.

courses.title: Yoga Teacher Training Course (200-hour)
courses.description: The ashram's residential month-long Sivananda teacher training, taught by swamis and senior staff and run nine times a year; the next intake begins on 4 December 2026, with further dates through 2027. A $500 deposit holds a place.

courses.title: An Ocean of Song: Mantra, Poetry, and Creative Practice
courses.description: A four-day Yoga Vacation Program with singer Jahnavi Harrison and musicians: noon workshops on the verse of old and modern saint-poets, and evening satsangs given over to call-and-response kirtan.

courses.title: Dance of Oneness: Whirling into the Infinite
courses.description: A four-day experiential course with Banafsheh Sayyad on sacred dance and feminine whirling in the tradition of Sama, drawing on Rumi's poetry in Persian and English and Iranian mysticism, with live music from Tony Khalife.

free_resources.title: Live Satsang
free_resources.description: The ashram's daily satsang streamed on Zoom at 6:00am and 8:00pm ET: half an hour of silent meditation, chanting, a teaching and closing prayers. Free to join after enrolling on the online platform; recordings are included.
